configurePresets.description: Local development on Windows 10: VS 2026 supports Windows 11 only (see Microsoft's system requirements), while VS 2022 Build Tools install on Windows 10 22H2 -- hence a different generator here than the 'ci' preset uses. Both are v14x toolchains and share the ABI, so a DLL built by either one loads in the same game; toolset is left at the VS 2022 default (v143). On Windows 11 with VS 2026 installed, switch this to 'Visual Studio 18 2026' + v145 to match upstream.
configurePresets.name: default

configurePresets.description: GitHub Actions preset, matching what windows-latest actually ships: Visual Studio 18 2026 with MSVC 14.51, i.e. toolset v145. A 'Visual Studio 17 2022' generator does NOT work there any more -- configure dies with 'could not find any instance of Visual Studio' *after* vcpkg has already found .../Visual Studio/18/Enterprise/VC/Tools/MSVC/14.51.36231/cl.exe and installed every dependency. A generator is mandatory in a configure preset: CMake will not fall back to its own detection. See the 'Report the Visual Studio instances' step in .github/workflows/build.yml for the evidence trail. COPY_BUILD is off because MMOHOTBAR_DEPLOY_DIR is a local path that does not exist on a runner.
configurePresets.name: ci
